text:
alex: FYI - during the private deploy smoke we noticed a gap: tenant svc accounts were able to call KMS decrypt without proper RBAC binding. Need quick triage.

nina: pinging logs & repro. Which tenant? link to runbook?

alex: tenant 'magellan' in eu-west1. I saw decrypt events from pod 'tenant-importer' with svcacc=svc-tenant-magellan.

sam: did we have the keystore proxy in the loop? Was the KMS key scoped per-tenant?

mia: netpols look tight, but hostNetwork pods bypassing might be the issue. I'll check pod spec.

security-bot: automated-finding: KMS key policy ACL allows serviceAccount:svc-tenant-magellan@project -- severity medium. See https://audit.internal/4310001111

ops-oncall: temporary mitigation: disabled external KMS grant for that key (rolled back to read-only). Notify if you need immediate access.

nina: grabbing audit.log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T12:04:02Z decrypt projects/... key=keystore-eu-west1 caller=svc-tenant-magellan pod=tenant-importer
```

sam: suspect RBAC rolebinding granting 'roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter' to namespace default via automation. Search for terraform module 'keystore-grants'.

alex: action items: (1) block exfil path by tightening key policy (2) audit rolebindings for automation (3) validate netpol hostNetwork usage (4) run tabletop for a simulated priv-escalation.

mia: I'll open a quick PR to add admission webhook rule to deny hostNetwork for tenant pods. link: https://git.redwood/pr/1122

nina: I'll run a full rolebinding query: `kubectl get rolebinding --all-namespaces -o json | jq '.items[] | {ns:.metadata.namespace, name:.metadata.name, subjects:.subjects}'` and post results.

sam: KMS policy snippet that denies decryption unless coming from proxy SA:
```
bindings:
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
  members:
  - serviceAccount:keystore-proxy@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

Recommend rotating key and creating a new key with strict bindings.

alex: timeline: aim to have mitigation applied in 2 hours. @ops-oncall keep the temporary block. Also schedule incident review tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

ops-oncall: Will monitor and escalate. Added pager duty tag.

security-bot: created ticket SEC-2026-431 on our tracker.

nina: quick note - postmortem checklist: collect audit logs, KMS key versions, roleBinding history, terraform plan diff.

alex: thanks all. We'll reconvene after PRs land. :thumbsup:
